entities.name: Livonian Order & German Baltic Nobility
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Livonian Order governed much of Latvia. Baltic German nobles controlled estates and politics. Latvian peasants faced deepening serfdom. The construction of great castles at Cēsis, Bauska, and Turaida. Conflicts between the Order and the Archbishop of Riga.
